policies.herding: heterogeneous price-taking threshold fleets (lags 1/1/2/3 min, bands 0.75/0.25, 0.70/0.30, 0.80/0.20, 0.75/0.25), closed-loop running signal
policies.herding_homogeneous: identical price takers (lag 1, bands 0.75/0.25), closed loop
policies.naive: each fleet internalises its own impact only (ignores the others)
policies.nash: symmetric Nash equilibrium of identical fleets (damped best responses)
policies.central: one optimiser for the whole implicit capacity (joint profit)
